needed.suggestion: Create a proper sidewalk on the left side to enhance pedestrian access.
Clear obstructions from the footway on the left side for safer pedestrian movement.
Repair uneven sections on the left footway to prevent tripping hazards.
Install a pedestrian crossing signal on the left side to improve crossing safety.
Mark a zebra crossing to improve visibility and safety.
Install a refuge island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
Add dropped kerbs to improve pedestrian crossing safety.
Increase street lighting to enhance visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.
